findings_closed.title: DeployTreasurySupply accepted exact 3,000,000 nanotons even though downstream genesis credit could not receive the required reserve after first-hop fees
findings_closed.resolution: DeployTreasurySupply now requires a 5,000,000 nanotons caller value: 3,000,000 nanotons downstream genesis envelope plus a 2,000,000 nanotons ATHMaster first-hop execution reserve. The treasury wallet receives the downstream envelope with SendPayFwdFeesSeparately.

findings_closed.title: DeployTreasurySupply overpayment was forwarded into the treasury ATH wallet as unaccounted TON balance
findings_closed.resolution: ATHMaster now forwards only the canonical downstream genesis envelope to the treasury ATH wallet and refunds non-dust caller overpayment to the treasury owner response destination. M47 refines dust handling: excess below 100,000 nanotons is retained as ATHMaster reserve rather than sent as a potentially failing refund action.

genesis_deploy_policy.dust_excess_policy: retain in ATHMaster balance as storage reserve
